findings.text: follow-on: the refusal covers an unresolvable PRESENTED identifier, but item (4) as the coordinator recorded it is the declared-beside-presented case ('an unresolvable value declared beside a presented one is still dropped from the shortfall comparison rather than refused', tests/test_cited_identifier_resolves.py:20-28, restated in reports/reckon/s22-coord/crpc-currency/report.md). That case is still silent at head, pinned unmodified by tests/test_a_short_commit_list_is_reported.py:209 (declared=[first, _GONE_40], presented=(first,) asserts None) and by test_a_declared_revision_that_does_not_resolve_is_not_named_missing. The presented-side repair is real and tested (test_a_presented_sha_that_resolves_to_no_object_is_refused_by_value raises at head, DID NOT RAISE at base), so this is a target ambiguity rather than an assertion change; the reviewer reads item (4) as the declared case.

follow-on: commits: names only 87107ce08, one of the run's three commits (87107ce08 code, 592883384 and 5600aee68 docs). The run's head, and the head the review is anchored at, is 5600aee68, so the record understates its own head; the promotion reads this line as the declared citation set and the review as the recorded head.

No deletions to production code, no test weakened or removed; the pre-existing pin tests in tests/test_a_short_commit_list_is_reported.py are untouched and pass.
item_verdicts.done_when: the node's done-when is items (2), (3) and (4) verified with a base arm, a head arm and a negative control. Met quantitatively: base arm at 33c5e761 with the new cases copied in is 3 failed, 340 passed, EXIT=1, the three new cases red (logs/base-gate.log), which I reproduced independently in a scratch base tree at 33c5e761 (3 failed, 2 passed, EXIT=1, the same three ids, reports.py exposed no _gate_log_revision_findings); head arm at 87107ce08 is 343 passed, EXIT=0, no failure id (logs/head-gate.log), which I reproduced for the new file (5 passed). NOT met for item (4) as the coordinator recorded it; recorded under follow_ons of the landing.
item_verdicts.goal: f-crpc-control-gate-repairs items (2), (3) and (4). Item (2) is met for the revision only: _gate_log_revision_findings (reckon/crew/reports.py:1072) is wired into audit_manifest (reckon/crew/reports.py:1296) and holds each suite arm's cited log's first line against the revision that arm records; the tree and command the template also names are not compared. Item (3) is met for the case it records: a log cited for one arm that carries another arm's run is reported naming both revisions (test_a_gate_log_naming_another_arms_revision_is_reported_with_both). Item (4) is NOT met as recorded: the coordinator's item names the declared-beside-presented silence ('an unresolvable value declared beside a presented one is still dropped from the shortfall comparison rather than refused', tests/test_cited_identifier_resolves.py:20-28, restated in the crpc-currency report), which is pinned unmodified by tests/test_a_short_commit_list_is_reported.py:209 and still silent at head; the repair refuses an unresolvable PRESENTED identifier instead (reckon/crew/promotion.py:873), which is a real but different silence in the same branch.
item_verdicts.manifest: read in full and passes its own new check: audit_manifest over the reviewed manifest with the reviewed tree's reports.py reports no findings, so the guard does not false-positive on the manifest that motivated it. The manifest is complete and its three arms carry log paths. Weakness: commits: (manifest.md:10) names only 87107ce08, one of the run's three commits, while the run's head is 5600aee68 (the at- path); the record understates its own head.
item_verdicts.write_paths: four changed paths against four declared (reckon/crew/reports.py, reckon/crew/promotion.py, tests/test_control_gate_repairs.py, docs/evidence/fragments/crew-runtime-positive-controls/control-gate-repairs.html): git diff 33c5e761..5600aee68 is exactly those four, 472 insertions, and nothing else. The declared figure path docs/figures/crew-runtime-positive-controls/ carries no committed file and the fragment embeds no figure; that is the only declared path left unused, and it is a gap rather than a write outside the fence.

justifications.durability: the new check is pinned by removing it (the declared mutation reds the first case, 2 failed, 3 passed, EXIT=1) and by a positive control (test_a_base_log_carrying_the_base_arms_own_revision_is_not_reported asserts silence when the arms match); the refusal couples to public behaviour (audit findings, a raised CrewError naming the value), not a private string.
justifications.evidence: the base arm is independently reproduced at 33c5e761 (3 failed, 2 passed, EXIT=1, the same three ids) and the head file is 5 passed; the added-failure set derived from the run's own baseline_suite and after_suite logs via review.added_failures_from_gate_logs is 0 (head has no FAILED/ERROR line, base has three); the negative control falsifies the new watch; the reviewed manifest passes its own check.
justifications.fit: the new reader reuses _read_control_log and sits beside _control_log_findings; the refusal reuses _commit_canonical_id and _resolve_commits, raising the same CrewError the citation branch raises; no orphaned symbol. Minor: _GATE_LOG_REVISION (reports.py:1055) reads the same first-line convention as review._LOGGED_REVISION_RE with a different spelling, a small duplication of one idea.
justifications.goal_fidelity: items (2) and (3) are met by a real write-time reader that fires on the first case (verified by removing it: 2 failed, 3 passed, EXIT=1, logs/negative-control.log), but item (4) as the coordinator recorded it is unaddressed — the declared-beside-presented silence remains pinned and silent at head, and the landing's own sentence names the presented list, a sibling silence the plan did not record.
justifications.scope_discipline: four changed paths equal the four declared, all inside the node's write paths; no out-of-scope edit, no weakened assertion, and the untouched pin tests still constrain the branch.
